data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (converter, add cities, holidays by country and month, email to ops with the right subject and body), but it ends with "send (or save the draft)" where the true workflow says never send and click Discard. It also hardcodes ops@example.com while listing recipient_email as a parameter, says "ahead" where the true body uses a variable offset, and does not mention the Mail tab switch or the To/Subject/Body clicks, so an automation built from it could send an email by mistake and would have to guess some details.
